That is incorrect behavior introduced by this diff, though minor UX-wise.

adjudication.rationale: In AddGuestsDialog.tsx, `isInvalidEmail` is set to `true` on failed validation in `handleAdd`, but it is only reset in the Cancel button handler. It is not cleared when the user edits emails via `MultiEmail` (`setMultiEmailValue` is called without `setIsInvalidEmail(false)`), nor when validation succeeds (no reset before/after `addGuestsMutation.mutate`). This means the invalid-email warning can persist after corrections/while submitting. The note about the Zod schema being defined inline is also accurate (it’s created inside the component and not exported), but the persistent invalid flag is a verifiable behavior defect.
